GetGoing does not publish a first-party public developer API; programmatic travel integration is provided by the separate, authorization-gated BCD Travel Developer Hub.

providers.name: Moonfare
providers.description: Moonfare is a digital investment platform that gives individual professional and high-net-worth investors access to private equity and venture capital funds that were historically reserved for institutions. The platform pools investor commitments into Luxembourg-based feeder funds, applies rigorous due diligence (approving only a small fraction of screened funds), and offers products spanning direct fund investments, portfolio-of-funds, co-investments, secondaries, and open-ended funds, with a digital secondary market for institutional-style liquidity. Moonfare handles capital calls, distributions, reporting, and administration through a technology-enabled onboarding and portfolio experience. Moonfare does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: OEN
providers.description: Oen (應援科技) is a Taiwan-based fintech company operating an integrated payments and CRM cloud platform. It provides multi-channel payment processing (credit cards, convenience-store payments, bank transfers, and subscriptions), electronic invoicing, and a supporter-relationship CRM covering event and ticketing management, member and volunteer management, merchandise/reward redemption, and email/SMS communications. The platform serves nonprofits, political organizations, educational institutions, entertainment events, and commercial merchants, with more than 600 organizations and individuals using Oen. The company runs an API Gateway and mobile-payment surface, a public responsible-disclosure and bug-bounty program, and displays PCI DSS Level 1, ISO 27001, and ISO 27701 trust badges.

providers.name: Satago
providers.description: Satago is a UK financial-technology platform offering a three-in-one cash flow management solution for small and medium-sized businesses: Risk Insights (real-time credit checks, risk bands, and suggested credit limits), Credit Control (automated invoice chasing with customizable email and SMS reminder sequences, statements, and late-fee handling), and Invoice Finance (fast, flexible funding with advance rates up to 90% on single or multiple invoices, offered as both selective and full facilities). The platform synchronizes with 300+ accounting packages including Sage, Xero, QuickBooks, KashFlow, and FreeAgent to keep debtor data current. Satago sells to businesses directly and through partners; it does not currently publish a public developer API, consuming the accounting platforms' APIs rather than exposing its own.

providers.name: Settle
providers.description: Settle is a financial operations platform built for consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands and ecommerce companies, unifying procurement, accounts payable automation, and working capital financing in one back office. Teams create and manage purchase orders, track goods received and true landed costs, collect and approve bills, pay vendors with real-time visibility, and access flexible inventory and growth financing ($20K-$15M) underwritten from payables and purchasing data. Founded in 2019 and backed by Ribbit Capital, Kleiner Perkins, and Founders Fund, Settle has funded more than $3 billion to brands. A developer API covering bill pay, payments, and landed-cost data is in early access via a public waitlist.

providers.name: Staircase
providers.description: Staircase, Inc. operates the Elephant Protocol (elephant.xyz), a decentralized property-data network that aggregates and cryptographically verifies fragmented county property and address records into trusted, agent-consumable data. It publishes 500,000+ enriched property data points and an unusually agent-native developer surface: a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (@elephant-xyz/mcp, both stdio and hosted), an Elephant CLI (@elephant-xyz/cli) for oracle data transformation and on-chain proof submission to Polygon, a fact-sheet generator, and a library of 14 published Agent Skills for county-data ingestion. An Enterprise API is offered to organizations at scale. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners; originally a mortgage-technology API company, now focused on real estate data infrastructure.

providers.name: Arrived
providers.description: Arrived is a real estate investment platform that lets individuals buy, own, and sell fractional shares of income-producing residential properties without the work of being a landlord. Investors browse curated single-family rentals, vacation rentals, funds, and real-estate debt offerings, invest in minutes, and receive passive rental income through dividend distributions plus potential appreciation while Arrived handles acquisition and property management. The company reports roughly 981K registered investors, $445M invested, and $95M distributed. Arrived is a consumer-facing investing product with a web and mobile app; it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal, so this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Bippit
providers.description: Bippit is a UK-based financial wellbeing platform that gives every employee access to personal, qualified financial coaching alongside AI-powered guidance available 24/7, planning and budgeting tools, payroll savings, and educational content and webinars. Sold to employers as a workplace benefit, it also provides organisations with aggregate financial-wellbeing insights and analytics. Bippit is FCA-regulated (No. 845814), ICO-registered (No. ZA533579), ISO 27001:2022 certified, and GDPR / UK DPA 2018 compliant, with data stored in the EEA. Backed by Techstars. Bippit publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web and compliance surface.

providers.name: Parafin
providers.description: Parafin is an embedded finance infrastructure company (founded 2020) that lets software platforms, marketplaces, and payment service providers offer capital, spend, and pay-over-time products to the small businesses on their platform. Parafin abstracts the hardest parts of launching a business-financing product — capital sourcing, regulatory and compliance know-how, underwriting and risk modeling, servicing, and collections — behind white-labeled REST APIs and embeddable UI widgets (Parafin Elements) shipped for React, Vue, and Angular. Products include Capital (revenue-based cash advances and flex term loans), Line of Credit, Spend (card and cash account), and Pay Over Time. Platforms integrate via a no-code option (Parafin Lite), low-code embedded Elements, or a custom API build. Notable customers include DoorDash and Mindbody. Backed by GGV Capital, Redpoint Ventures, and Ribbit Capital.
